step.match_events: Matching event titles to opportunity titles

blocker.no_opportunity: no opportunity to create a shift under
blocker.ends_before_start: a shift that ends before it starts

matchKind.fuzzy: Matched to {category} by wording alone, scoring {score} of 100. Worth a look.

row.noOpportunity: Unable to match to an opportunity
row.duplicate: Identical to "{title}" earlier in this run. Repeated rows are dropped, so this one creates nothing.
row.capped: Created as {minutes} min, the longest this opportunity allows

uncollectedNote.search: No configured search term found these events, so they were excluded. You may note these events to improve the collection model and add these events to the run.
uncollectedNote.excluded: The title carries a term the deployment excludes. You may note these events to improve the collection model, although you may not add them to the run.
uncollectedNote.allday: You may not add these events to the run.
uncollectedNote.untitled: No title, so there is nothing to match an opportunity on, and nothing to note for the model either. These cannot be added to a run.

logAction.set_start: Set the shift start of {subject} to {time}.
logAction.set_end: Set the shift end of {subject} to {time}.
logAction.reset_slots: Reset the volunteers wanted on {subject} to what the opportunity asks for.
logAction.added: Added {subject}, which no configured search returned.
